title: An atomic certificate for triangular-lattice universal optimality
main_claim: Among locally finite planar configurations with centered disk density one, the density-one triangular lattice minimizes the lower energy per particle for every nonnegative completely monotone g(r^2), with infinite energies allowed. The proof builds sharp Gaussian minorants f_alpha (f_alpha<=k_alpha, hat f_alpha>=0, contact on A\{0}, Fourier zeros on A*\{0}) from a modulo-36 interpolation with two 20x20 finite blocks and an l^1 tail correction.
coverage: I read the whole paper and checker. Energy section: I checked the Fourier-mass lemma (Cauchy-Schwarz/Plancherel constants), the density-only LP bound, the reciprocal-parameter duality (hat k_alpha = alpha^{-1}k_{1/alpha}, A*=JA), the Laplace representation proof (Taylor remainder monotonicity, nu_l transform identity, compactness, tail control) and the Fatou/Tonelli mixing including the t=0 atom. Construction: I recomputed the residue set I mod 36 by brute force. I rederived the atomic masses (csc^2/cot Laurent expansion) and the absolutely continuous tail densities, plus the W variation entries. I checked the complex-Gaussian transform and wave parameters, and the four decay exponents exactly (rational). I checked the direct, repeated (alias) and target jet formulas, the repetition norm (2.4e-10), and the polytope inclusion (z_max=0.3907<Z, exp bounds, Delta max 1.43e-4). I checked the frequency-monotonicity argument for the tail envelopes (1/X_min < 3k < pi k n) and the curvature t-extremum argument. I redid the Schur/Neumann error arithmetic (e'_+=1.8e-9, e'_-=3.36e-9, e_+=1.1798e-5, e_-=6.122e-6, averages <1e-5 and <3e-9). I verified the Gaussian divided-difference lemma symbolically (q identity, q''=x^2e^{-x}, monotonicity of r, r(Z,.5)=836500/974643). I checked the exceptional cubic Bernstein derivation and B_2 max 3.481286, the sine-barrier log-concavity, and the far-range K margins. I reran verification/check_certificate.py: exit 0, about 3 s. I cross-read its code against the appendix recipes: P convolution signs, Q_n/D_n folding, makecol, R/R0 column ordering, target rows, U_± and A_i assembly, Taylor rows, Bernstein conversion, exact polytope row minimum, exceptional-polynomial assembly, envelope and curvature tables. I did not independently reimplement the interval Gauss-Jordan; I relied on the checker's code, which I reviewed.
sibling_notes: Companion of Universal-optimality-of-the-triangular-lattice-September-23-2026 (sibling rank175: no_gap_found). This paper's energy reduction is self-contained and proves the Schwartz LP and the Bernstein-Widder step locally. It cites the companions only for precedent and method, not for any lemma it needs, so there is no circular dependence. The finite certificate is independent (mod-36, 20 nodes, atomic spectra, a single parameter polytope instead of parameter intervals).
